references.title: de.wikipedia: Śrem
references.supports: Śrem (deutsch Schrimm), a town on the Warthe south of Posen, in the Prussian province of Posen from 1818

notes.rationale: The German name of Śrem, the town of the Spottvers Schrimm / Ist schlimm. No dictionary splits it, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050), so it is a bottom word: the Root schrimm and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (Schrimms) (ADR 0051).
